answers.core: The affected controls (`Label`, `RichTextLabel`) are part of core.
answers.workaround:
No workarounds via script that can address all of the issues are known at this time:
- Adjusting the positioning of the vscrollbar when a RichTextLabel collapses
- Generic support for a panel to support all fonts without needing per-font margin properties, Themes, and/or Theme Overrides for on MarginContainer.

title: Add font-specific alignment customizations for Label rendering
